description: patroni.yml for Patroni 3.x with an etcd3 DCS.

fields.description: Cluster name; every member of one Patroni cluster shares it. Filled by the server from the run's topology.
fields.name: scope
fields.title: Cluster scope

fields.description: Unique member name inside the scope. Filled by the server from the node's role index.
fields.name: name
fields.title: Node name

fields.description: Key prefix Patroni uses inside the DCS; rendered as the top-level `namespace` key (the field cannot be named `namespace`: it is a CEL reserved word).
fields.name: dcs_namespace
fields.title: DCS namespace

fields.description: host:port the Patroni REST API binds to; rendered as restapi.listen.
fields.name: restapi_listen
fields.title: REST API listen

fields.description: host:port other members and haproxy use to reach this node's REST API. Filled by the server from the node's address.
fields.name: restapi_connect_address
fields.title: REST API connect address

fields.description: host:port list of the etcd v3 cluster backing the DCS. Filled by the server from the etcd topology.
fields.name: etcd3_hosts
fields.title: etcd3 hosts

fields.description: The etcd3 host list as an indented YAML sequence (the render context does not expand lists).
fields.name: etcd3_hosts_rendered
fields.title: Rendered etcd3 hosts

fields.description: Lifetime of the leader lock: how long a leaderless cluster waits before failover.
fields.name: ttl
fields.title: Leader TTL

fields.description: Sleep between Patroni's heartbeat cycles.
fields.name: loop_wait
fields.title: Loop wait

fields.description: Timeout for DCS and PostgreSQL operations before they are retried.
fields.name: retry_timeout
fields.title: Retry timeout

fields.description: Replication lag, in bytes, above which a replica may not be promoted.
fields.name: maximum_lag_on_failover
fields.title: Maximum lag on failover

fields.description: Synchronous replication mode. `quorum` (quorum-based commit) is the Patroni 3.x addition.
fields.name: synchronous_mode
fields.title: Synchronous mode

fields.description: Never drop back to asynchronous replication, even with no healthy synchronous standby: writes stall instead.
fields.name: synchronous_mode_strict
fields.title: Synchronous mode strict

fields.description: Number of synchronous standbys Patroni maintains when synchronous_mode is on.
fields.name: synchronous_node_count
fields.title: Synchronous node count

fields.description: Keep the primary running when the DCS is unreachable but every member answers the failsafe endpoint. Patroni 3.0+.
fields.name: failsafe_mode
fields.title: Failsafe mode

fields.description: Rejoin a demoted primary with pg_rewind instead of a full basebackup. Product default true: a stroppy rerun must not spend a basebackup on every failover.
fields.name: use_pg_rewind
fields.title: Use pg_rewind

fields.description: Have Patroni manage physical replication slots for the members.
fields.name: use_slots
fields.title: Use replication slots

fields.description: host:port PostgreSQL binds to; rendered as postgresql.listen.
fields.name: postgresql_listen
fields.title: PostgreSQL listen

fields.description: host:port other members use to reach this PostgreSQL. Filled by the server from the node's address.
fields.name: postgresql_connect_address
fields.title: PostgreSQL connect address

fields.description: PGDATA directory Patroni initializes and manages.
fields.name: data_dir
fields.title: Data directory

fields.description: Directory holding the PostgreSQL binaries; empty means look them up on PATH.
fields.name: bin_dir
fields.title: Binary directory

fields.description: Path of the pg_hba.conf rendered from cfg.pg_hba.conf@1. Patroni's inline `pg_hba` list is not used: the file is the single source.
fields.name: pg_hba_path
fields.title: pg_hba.conf path

fields.description: Superuser role Patroni connects with.
fields.name: superuser_username
fields.title: Superuser

fields.description: Password of the superuser role.
fields.name: superuser_password
fields.title: Superuser password

fields.description: Role used for streaming replication between members.
fields.name: replication_username
fields.title: Replication user

fields.description: Password of the replication role.
fields.name: replication_password
fields.title: Replication password

fields.description: Role pg_rewind runs as; only needed when use_pg_rewind is true and the superuser is not used.
fields.name: rewind_username
fields.title: Rewind user

fields.description: Password of the rewind role.
fields.name: rewind_password
fields.title: Rewind password

fields.description: Exclude this member from leader races.
fields.name: tag_nofailover
fields.title: nofailover

fields.description: Make the /replica REST endpoint return 503 so load balancers skip this member.
fields.name: tag_noloadbalance
fields.title: noloadbalance

fields.description: Prefer this member as the source of a basebackup for new replicas.
fields.name: tag_clonefrom
fields.title: clonefrom

fields.description: Never choose this member as a synchronous standby.
fields.name: tag_nosync
fields.title: nosync

fields.description: Watchdog use: `automatic` uses it when available, `required` refuses to promote without it, `off` disables it.
fields.name: watchdog_mode
fields.title: Watchdog mode

fields.description: Watchdog device node.
fields.name: watchdog_device
fields.title: Watchdog device

fields.description: Seconds the watchdog must fire before the leader key expires; -1 keeps a fixed half-TTL margin.
fields.name: watchdog_safety_margin
fields.title: Watchdog safety margin

fields.description: PostgreSQL parameters Patroni itself must manage in the DCS (the rest of postgresql.conf comes from cfg.postgresql.conf@<major>). Entry order is not preserved.
fields.name: postgresql_parameters
fields.title: Patroni-owned PostgreSQL parameters

fields.description: The postgresql_parameters map as an indented YAML mapping.
fields.name: postgresql_parameters_rendered
fields.title: Rendered parameters

rules.message: ttl must be at least loop_wait + 2 * retry_timeout, otherwise the leader key expires mid-cycle
synchronous_mode_strict requires synchronous_mode to be on or quorum
watchdog safety_margin must be below ttl
